functions.description: Parse base syslog structure: timestamp, host, optional source IP, process, pid, and message
Extract the md device identifier (e.g. md0, md1) from the message regardless of source line type
Extract uptime timestamp and detail text from kernel-originated mdstat messages
Extract mdadm event type and optional component device from mdadm-originated messages

conf.regex: /^(?<mdadm_event>\w+) event detected on md device \/dev\/\w+(?:,\s*component device \/dev\/(?<component_device>\w+))?/

functions.description: Classify action and severity based on message content, and derive event time from syslog timestamp

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/Disk failure|Fail event|disabling device/) ? 'failure' : message.match(/recovery done|SpareActive|RebuildStarted|full recovery|recovery of RAID/) ? 'recovery' : message.match(/degraded|WARNING/) ? 'degraded' : message.match(/DeviceDisappeared|NewArray|capacity change|unknown partition table/) ? 'topology_change' : 'info'

add.name: severity
add.value: message.match(/failure|Fail event|degraded|WARNING/) ? 'high' : message.match(/DeviceDisappeared|capacity change|unknown partition table/) ? 'medium' : 'info'
